prompt: How do I use Designer to format a slide in PowerPoint?
completion:
To format a slide in PowerPoint using the Designer feature, follow these steps:

1. **Open PowerPoint** and create a new presentation or open an existing one.
2. **Go to the slide** you want to format.
3. **Click on the "Design" tab** in the ribbon at the top of the screen.
4. **Click on "Design Ideas"** in the Design tab. This will open the Designer pane on the right side of the screen.
5. **Review the suggested designs** that appear in the Designer pane. You can scroll through the options to see different layouts and formats.
6. **Hover over a design** to see a preview of how it will look on your slide.
7. **Click on the design** you like to apply it to your slide. The slide will automatically be formatted according to the chosen design.
8. **Customize further** if needed. After applying a design, you can manually adjust elements like text, images, and shapes to fine-tune the look of your slide.

If you don't see the Designer feature, make sure you are using a relatively recent version of PowerPoint (2019 or later) and that your content includes images or text that Designer can work with.
